create_ViTConfig_default: create a ViTConfig with default vit-base-patch16-224 configuration parameters
create_ViTConfig_custom: create a ViTConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and image_size values
create_ViTConfig_pooler: create a ViTConfig with custom pooler_output_size and pooler_act activation function
create_ViTConfig_image_params: create a ViTConfig with custom image_size, patch_size, and num_channels for input images
create_ViTConfig_attention: create a ViTConfig with custom num_attention_heads, intermediate_size, and qkv_bias settings
